parsed.rationale: Two identical `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` type-alias-object declarations exist across two packages — one in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and one in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS) — with `shared_field_count: 4` and no differing slots, confirming they are exact duplicates. Since the type already lives in the `Metadata` package's test target, the canonical home is there. Consolidating to a single definition in the `Metadata` test target eliminates the risk of the two definitions drifting apart.
